objectives: Identify sk as the onset in taught words.
Compare rimes in controlled words and explain how endings differ.
Decode each complete word accurately rather than guessing from the onset.
Use word-family evidence to read a short controlled word list.
concepts: The onset is the consonant sound or blend before the vowel.
The rime includes the vowel and any following consonants.
Words may share an onset but have different rimes.
Whole-word decoding checks onset, vowel, and ending.

definitions.definition: The consonant sound or blend before the vowel in a syllable.
The vowel and any sounds that follow it in a syllable.
A group of words that share a rime or spelling pattern.
